newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down, seen steady to weak.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down, seen steady to weak.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished lower on Thursday on foreign selling in select blue chips and lack of support from local institutions, dealers said.
They said lack of institutional support kept small investors on the selling side. They saw the market trading in a narrow range or weakening on Sunday after the Friday-Saturday weekend.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 14.72 points, or one percent, to end at 1,460.58. Losers led gainers 159 to 96. Turnover rose to 40.75 million shares from 40.56 million on Wednesday.
Hub Power Co fell 0.45 rupees to 34.05 rupees and Pakistan State Oil 6.0 to 377. PTCL fell 0.05 to 28.25. ICI Pakistan fell 0.50 to 22.15 and FFC Jordan Fertilizer 0.50 to 15.
Dewan Salman Fibre rose 0.60 to 36.60. Faysal Bank fell 1.50 to 22.50. Adamjee Insurance fell 6.0 to 92. Engro Chemical fell 4.0 to 142.
